description: Geth (go-ethereum) is the most widely-used execution client for the Ethereum network. Post-Merge, it must be paired with a consensus client — see the Lighthouse template in this list — to fully sync and validate the chain.
name: geth
note: A full Ethereum mainnet sync needs 1TB+ of fast (NVMe recommended) disk space and can take several days.
